objective: Find 1st alpha for ASI/MINVOL1M/D1. Threshold sh>1.58. Currently 0/3. news104 cap~1.0, news29 cap~0.21, model144 excluded.

star_field.desc: avg normalized tone (pos-neg)/(pos+neg) bounded [-1,1]. CONTINUOUS SENTIMENT SCORE - most template-compatible field across all 3 news datasets. Like news104 marketimpactscore but tone-based.

other_continuous.desc: number of headlines - MOST POPULAR field, attention/volume

field_analysis.rationale: tone_score is continuous sentiment (template-native). mention counts = attention (weak in news104 but 863 alphas suggests popularity). Prioritize tone_score with 6 variants incl z60 (best sh per handoff, targets 1.58 blocker).

hypotheses.tone_score_momentum: ts_mean(tone,20)=avg recent sentiment. group_rank within subindustry=relative sentiment. ts_zscore=z-score momentum. Classic sentiment-momentum alpha.
hypotheses.direction: Both directions tested - base (high rank=high sentiment, momentum) vs flipped (high rank=LOW sentiment, contrarian/reversal).
hypotheses.outer_window: z40=best rn_sh, z30=best asi_jpn, z60=best sh (mutually exclusive per handoff). z60 most relevant for 1.58 sh target.
hypotheses.expectation: tone_score should beat news104 marketimpactscore (1.01) if sentiment signal stronger on ASI. If sh>1.3&2Y>1 -> b9 optimize. If caps ~1.0 -> news exhausted, forum search + pivot.
